title: Elementalist armor
wikitext: {{TOCright}} A full set of [[Elementalist]] armor consists of an eye or aura, robes, gloves, leggings and shoes. ==Armor bonuses== [[Basic armor|Basic]] Elementalist armor provides up to a maximum of 60 [[Armor rating|armor]], 10 extra [[energy]] and 2 extra [[energy recovery]].
